B0420.title: Audio System Internal Failure
B0420.description: The audio head unit reports an internal self-test failure. Symptoms include silent output, frozen display, or repeated reboots of the infotainment system.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0425.title: Audio Amplifier Internal Failure
B0425.description: The audio amplifier reports an internal self-test failure. Sound output may be distorted, missing on some channels, or the amplifier enters a protection mode.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0440.title: Bluetooth Module Fault
B0440.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the Bluetooth module. Pairing with phones may fail or audio streaming drops out.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0445.title: USB Hub Fault
B0445.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the internal USB hub. USB ports may not detect connected devices reliably.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0450.title: Microphone Circuit
B0450.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the hands-free microphone circuit. Voice commands and phone calls may have poor audio quality.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0455.title: Display Module Internal Failure
B0455.description: The instrument cluster or central display module reports an internal self-test failure. Pixels may be missing, the screen may stay dark, or warning indicators may not display correctly.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0460.title: Bluetooth Antenna Circuit
B0460.description: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the Bluetooth antenna circuit. Range and connection stability may be reduced.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system

B0490.title: Display Backlight Circuit
B0490.description: The infotainment or instrument cluster module has detected a fault in the display backlight circuit. The display may stay dark or be unreadable in low light.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
